source.rule: collection POST plus unique item GET
response id convention; route parameter matched to property

entities.delete: not emitted: absence response is not explicitly documented
entities.complex_actions: not emitted: transition effects are not specified by schemas alone

inference_policy: generic schema/title/key conventions; ambiguous cases fail; these conventions are not mathematical consequences of OpenAPI
oracle_policy: expected request projection, generic write/read preservation hypothesis; no observed-response learning of expected quantity
observation_support: shared capture/readback primitives; see process bindings

process_bindings.dependency_rule: verified lifecycle revision; identity from DAL/RTV
process_bindings.expected_state: verified DAL snapshot; transition semantics not inferred
process_bindings.success_state_mismatch: recorded diagnostic; no implicit preservation assertion
